name: Analyze
description: Analyze a new issue, internally review the plan for gaps, and update the issue description with a grounded implementation approach. Triggered when an issue enters the "Todo" board column (rename the trigger filter to match your board's column or label names).

workflows.name: Analyze
workflows.description: Reads a freshly opened issue, inspects the source code, reviews the analysis for gaps, and updates the issue body with a marked Conduit analysis section.

nodes.name: Review
nodes.instructionsAppend: Do not post to the connected platform from this node — the downstream Publish agent handles all platform updates.

nodes.name: Publish
nodes.instructionsAppend:
Update the source issue body in place. Read the current body from `AgentContext.trigger.issue.body` (do not refetch). Follow the Publish marker contract: locate the existing `<!-- conduit:start --> … <!-- conduit:end -->` block and replace ONLY its contents; append a fresh block at the end if absent. Never touch content outside the markers. The block should contain a concise summary, proposed approach, likely files or areas, tests to run, and a `## Open questions` subsection when the request is ambiguous. Do not post a normal comment.

Decision tracing on rerun: when a prior `<!-- conduit:start --> … <!-- conduit:end -->` block exists, scan its `## Open questions` subsection. For each question, look for user-added prose inserted after the question (and after its options block, if any) within the prior block — any text the agent did not write. If that text confidently answers the question, fold it into a `**Decision (<topic>):** <summary>` line under a new `## Decisions` subsection in the new block, and drop the original question + its options from `## Open questions`. If the user's text doesn't confidently map to a specific question, preserve the question as-is rather than misclassify. Carry unresolved questions forward verbatim.
